methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified roster of twelve wet/dry shop vacuums (2.5 to 16 gallons). Each product's defining specs and price were re-checked against manufacturer pages (ridgid.com, craftsman.com, vacmaster.com, stanleytools.com, shopvac.com) and reputable retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, Tractor Supply, Amazon, Webstaurantstore, Toolbox Supply, Blain's Farm and Fleet). Prices reflect current US retail (MSRP where the manufacturer publishes it, otherwise the lowest widely-available published retail price); priceNote states the basis. Corrections vs the draft: Shop-Vac 5989300 price 75.44->143.48 (stale; Walmart current); DEWALT DXV10P price 143.98->162.99 (aggregator number not a published retail price; Amazon lowest current); RIDGID HD0600 price 62.97->91.97 (unverifiable; Home Depot HD0600B current); CRAFTSMAN CMXEVBE17595 CFM 176->190.8 (official spec corroborated by McGuckin/McCoy's/Hardware Store); RIDGID HD1400 blower_function false->true (has rear blower port, 165 CFM blow, per RIDGID accessory spec and reviews); WORKSHOP WS1600SS price 284.37->260.99 (aggregator stale; multiple current retailers). Bad/unverifiable corroboration URLs replaced with topical primary retailers (Vacmaster Beast Newegg->Amazon; DEWALT source aggregator->Amazon; WORKSHOP source aggregator->Tractor Supply). Boolean true/false for wet_dry and blower_function; tank_capacity_gal and peak_hp unitless; hose_diameter_in and cord_length_ft carry implied imperial units; max_airflow_cfm unitless CFM. NULL used where no source published a value (peak_hp for the amp-rated VK811PH; max_airflow_cfm for CMXEVBE17594). All releaseDate values are null (not published by manufacturers for these consumer SKUs). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: RIDGID 14 Gallon 6.0 Peak HP NXT Wet/Dry Vac HD1400
products.priceNote: Recent Home Depot sale price (regular ~$139); $119 confirmed via Home Depot listing
